description.value: Sopra Sotto is a sit-down Italian pizzeria and pasta restaurant on Burnaby's Hastings Street corridor, one of two Lower Mainland locations. The kitchen makes fresh pasta in-house and fires pizzas in a wood-burning oven, with a full menu spanning antipasti, pastas, and Neapolitan-style pies. The restaurant accommodates large group bookings and private buyouts, making it a viable stop for club rides or touring groups.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 68m; stands (2 spaces) at 87m. Total: 4 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is the Burnaby location of Sopra Sotto, an Italian restaurant at 4022 Hastings Street, matching all OSM contact fields. Menus on the website explicitly label items with (v) for vegetarian, (gf) for gluten-friendly, and offer vegan mozzarella as an add-on, confirming dietary options. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, takeout, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active Italian restaurant with a confirmed address, active website, and full menus; a useful dining stop for touring cyclists on the Hastings Street corridor in Burnaby.
enrichment_extras.notes: The website covers both the Vancouver (1510 Commercial Drive) and Burnaby (4022 Hastings Street) locations. This OSM record corresponds specifically to the Burnaby location, which is correctly identified.
